description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). ALL four LUT modules replaced by MultiNapLut = base NAP=6 'interaction' LUT + a NAP=1 'main-effect' LUT built on the SAME anchor pairs (one 2-row table per anchor pair of the base), outputs summed. NAP=1 tables get ~B/2 tokens/row -> near-zero gradient noise, giving a stable additive component to test whether it speeds/cleans convergence (the GN exp455 dead-end showed the bottleneck is gradient noise, not conditioning; this attacks noise directly via dense 2-row tables). Cost: +~19% params, (1+6)x LUT lookup bandwidth. Non-LUT stay AdamW. Saves checkpoint.
